title: Villager Bonus Drops
description: 给村民做了掉落物，让你的生存前期不在烦恼，让村民不在没用,使他们掉落皮革制品和工作方块（作者baifeng233）/I created drop items for villagers, so that you won't be troubled during the early stages of survival, and villagers won't be useless. They will drop leather products and work blocks (by baifeng233)
